audit_item: F7 / release Native accumulator indexes after report finalization
finding: A successfully finalized NativeReportAccumulator retained deduplication and cashflow-alignment dictionary tables even though the emitted report already owned its detached output collections.
change: Clear fill, Funding, liquidation identity/quantity, and timestamp-to-cashflow indexes only after the full report has been assembled successfully. Keep report facts, cashflow output, and final snapshot available to callers.
boundary: Dictionary shallow-size measurement is a synthetic structural check, not process RSS. Unique facts required by the report contract remain O(n), and the full-history Native RSS/trajectory profile plus authenticated real-history Train evidence remain open.
